steps.note: Owning company: new id, name suffixed, contact email/phone cleared (notification targets). Its users, sibling properties, regions and groups the property does not use are not copied.
Company-level PMS credential: secrets and provider identifiers cleared, display settings kept.
Only the region the property belongs to (Region#name is unique application-wide, so it is suffixed).
Only the portfolio group the property belongs to (name unique application-wide, code unique with properties).
The property. deleted_ids (tour stop ids) is remapped after the stops are cloned.
Property PMS credential: secrets and provider identifiers cleared, display settings kept.
CRM credential: provider and every secret/identifier cleared.
Property favourites: unit/amenity id arrays remapped; the per-visitor-email favourites (PII) are emptied.
"Other" lock descriptions: text only, no credentials.

Units with their plots; access codes cleared, lock_provider kept (no lock account or device is copied). units.floorplan_id is the PMS floor plan code (a string resolved through floorplans.provider_floorplan_id within the property), so it is copied as is.
Unit/amenity doors and map access points; a door whose record no longer exists is skipped.
Detect Hallways runs: client_request_id is unique, so each clone gets a fresh one.
Wayfinding nodes; next_points (hallway ids) is remapped after the pass. A legacy row with NULL community_id stays NULL, as on the source.
The property tour(s) (tour_user_id IS NULL); per-visitor tours are excluded. sort_hash / copy_sort_hash (stop ids) are remapped after the stops. Card requirement (Stripe) turned off.
Scheduling and booking rules; the ID-verification charge (Stripe) is turned off.
Stops of the property tour; a stop whose unit/amenity/elevator no longer exists is skipped.
Legacy routing paths owned by a cloned stop; the to/from endpoints are remapped, an endpoint outside the clone is cleared.
Launch form statuses of every cloned record (polymorphic statusable, remapped).
